name: Harem
overview: The biblical account in Esther 2 reveals the structure and function of the Persian harem, described as the 'house of the women' where young virgins were gathered and cared for under the supervision of royal chamberlains such as Hege and Shaashgaz. These women underwent purification and preparation before meeting the king, and only those who pleased him were called by name and granted continued access to his presence. This arrangement highlights the ordered and custodial nature of the Persian royal household as depicted in Scripture.
